headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty extended losing streak to eighth week amid record bear run.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Nifty and Sensex recorded their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years
Persistent FII selling and volatility continue to weigh on market sentiment
Significant market capitalization erosion of approximately ₹5-6 trillion in recent sessions
Weakness in the Nifty Auto sector, which slipped 3% during the last trading session
whatHappening: Government raised the deepwater gas price ceiling to $9.89/MMBtu while capping APM gas at $7
Reliance and Nayara are benefiting from a diesel boom while state-run OMCs face financial pressure
Major IPOs for Jio and B2B commerce firm OfBusiness are planned for late 2026 and 2027
Appliance makers anticipate double-digit growth during the festival season despite recent price hikes
summary: The Indian market is closed for the weekend following a historic eighth consecutive weekly decline for the Nifty and Sensex. On the last trading day, the Sensex dropped 571 points, marking the longest losing streak in 25 years amid heavy FII selling. Investors are now looking toward upcoming mega-IPOs and festive season demand for a potential recovery.
